# AutoAPI — Free AI API Discovery & Zero-Interruption Local Smart Router

**AutoAPI** is a local-first, two-tier AI API discovery and intelligent routing platform designed for developers and high-token coding agents (**OpenCode**, **Cline**, **Roo Code**, **Continue**, and any OpenAI SDK client).

It pairs an automated **Discovery Cloud Catalog & Community Radar** with a **100% local OpenAI-compatible proxy, encrypted key vault, hybrid quota tracker, and real-time web dashboard** running on `127.0.0.1:4141`. Your API keys, prompts, and code traffic never leave your computer except to the upstream provider you select.

---

## System Architecture

AutoAPI follows strict separation of concerns across two independent layers:

| Layer | Environment | Responsibilities | Communication |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **1. Discovery Cloud** | Scheduled GitHub Actions | Scans community feeds and official provider docs, extracts structured provider metadata, probes endpoint health, and publishes a versioned `catalog/catalog.json`. | Local engine pulls read-only JSON on startup and every 6 hours. |
| **2. Local Engine & Dashboard** | `127.0.0.1:4141` (Localhost) | AES-256-GCM key vault, OpenAI-compatible `/v1` proxy, protocol adapters, smart fallback router, hybrid quota tracker, SQLite storage, and React dashboard. | Coding agents connect to `http://127.0.0.1:4141/v1`; proxy calls upstream AI providers directly. |

---

## Key Capabilities

- **Zero-Interruption Failover**: Automatically detects per-minute (`429` RPM/TPM and `413` ITPM/OTPM), daily (`429` RPD), `401/403` invalid key, `402` exhausted credits (isolating paid models on mixed gateways so `:free` models on the same key stay active), `400` context overflow, and `5xx`/timeout errors and silently reroutes to the next eligible model in your chain.
- **Same-Provider Sibling Key Auto-Rotation (`autoRotateKeys`)**: Automatically rotates across multiple active vault keys on the same provider before failing over to downstream providers in your chain.
- **Live Callable Model Sync & Free/Paid Tagging**: Automatically queries each provider's live `/models` endpoint when testing/saving/syncing keys, prunes stale uncallable IDs, accurately classifies `Free` vs `Paid` tiers on mixed gateways (OpenRouter, TokenHarbor), and surfaces `Free only` filters in the UI.
- **Pre-First-Byte SSE Streaming Buffer**: Holds HTTP `200` headers until the upstream stream emits its first valid chunk. If a provider fails before the first byte arrives, AutoAPI fails over silently without dropping your IDE agent session. Mid-stream failures after tokens start flowing emit a clean SSE `error` event without corrupting streamed text.
- **Real-World Coding Agent & Protocol Hardening**:
  - **OpenAI-Compatible**: Passthrough + per-model parameter sanitizer (`max_tokens` vs `max_completion_tokens`), proactive `maxOutputTokens` clamping + reactive `400`/`422` limit learning, automatic `stream_options` fallback retry, `developer` → `system` role fallback on non-OpenAI hosts, deterministic 9-char alphanumeric `tool_call_id` remapping for Mistral, normalization of alternative `reasoning` fields into `reasoning_content`, and proactive + reactive stripping of `reasoning_content` / `reasoning` / `reasoning_details` from multi-turn message history on strict endpoints.
  - **Google Gemini Native**: Bidirectional translator (`x-goog-api-key` header auth, turn coalescing, recursive JSON Schema sanitization for tool calls, `part.thought` → `reasoning_content`, SSE & JSON responses).
  - **Anthropic Messages Native**: Bidirectional translator (`x-api-key`, `tool_use` ↔ `tool_calls` with `^[a-zA-Z0-9_-]{1,64}$` ID sanitization, empty text block removal, `thinking` / `thinking_delta` → `reasoning_content`, SSE event mapping).
- **Capability & TPM Guards**: Uses `gpt-tokenizer` to estimate incoming prompt + tool schema tokens and skips models lacking required context window, tool calling, vision, or sufficient TPM allowance in `0ms`.
- **Routing Strategies**:
  - `priority`: Follows your drag-and-drop fallback chain order.
  - `least-used`: Balances load across keys/models by remaining quota ratio with round-robin tie-breaking.
  - `lowest-latency`: Ranks eligible models by rolling average Time-To-First-Token (TTFT) across the last 10 requests.
- **Hybrid Quota Tracker**: Reads authoritative `x-ratelimit-*`, `Retry-After`, and `anthropic-ratelimit-*` HTTP headers first (recovering dynamically synced header limits when cooldowns or 60s windows reset), and falls back to a local 60-second sliding window and timezone-aware daily ledger (`rolling-60s`, `utc-midnight`, DST-accurate `pacific-midnight`).
- **Community Free API Radar**: Scans live developer announcements across **X**, **Reddit**, **GitHub**, **OpenRouter Free** (`:free` models), and custom RSS feeds with 3-pillar relevance scoring, link health verification, and a pinned Featured directory (`mnfst/awesome-free-llm-apis`).
- **Real-Time Web Dashboard**: Single-port React UI (`Home`, `Free API Radar`, `Providers & Vault`, `Routing Studio`, `Activity`, `Connect Agents`, `Settings`) powered by Server-Sent Events (`/api/events`), including a `24h`/`7d` time-series telemetry chart, live SSE streaming playground with reasoning preview, TTFT & scrubbed debug payload inspector, one-click non-destructive agent config installer, and Dark/Light themes.

---

## Error Classification & Cooldown State Machine

| Upstream Condition | Classification | Routing Action | Cooldown Policy |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| `429` (RPM / TPM) or `413` (ITPM / OTPM) | `rate_limit_rpm` | Failover immediately to next candidate | `Retry-After` / reset header, or `30s`–`60s` default |
| `429` (Daily RPD) | `rate_limit_rpd` | Failover immediately to next candidate | Until provider reset (`utc-midnight` / `pacific-midnight`) |
| `401` / `403` | `invalid_key` | Failover and raise Dashboard key alert | Key paused indefinitely until replaced/re-enabled |
| `402` (Paid model on mixed gateway) | `credits_exhausted` | Failover; pause only that paid model | Paid model paused (`:free` models on same key stay active) |
| `402` (Paid-only provider) | `credits_exhausted` | Failover and mark key exhausted | Key paused until updated/reset |
| `400` / `422` (`stream_options`, `max_tokens`, or `reasoning_content` mismatch) | Auto-Heal Retry | Sanitize parameter/message and retry same candidate once | Cached per `providerId:modelId`; zero quota penalty |
| `400` / `413` (Context Overflow) | `context_overflow` | Filter to wider context or alternate provider and retry | No cooldown applied to key |
| `400` (Malformed Request) | `bad_request` | Return error directly to client | No cooldown applied to key |
| `500` / `502` / `503` / `504` / Timeout | `upstream_error` / `timeout` | Failover immediately to next candidate | Exponential backoff (`2m` → `5m` → `15m`) |

## Supported Providers (Curated Starter Catalog)

## Quickstart

### Prerequisites
- **Node.js `>= 22.0.0`**
- **pnpm `>= 9.0.0`**

### Run with npm / npx

```bash
# Run immediately via npx (Node.js >= 22)
npx @autoapidev/autoapi start

# Or install globally (exposes the `autoapi` command)
npm install -g @autoapidev/autoapi
autoapi start
```

### Build & Run from Source

```bash
# 1. Install dependencies across all workspace packages
pnpm install

# 2. Build shared schemas, discovery collectors, core engine, dashboard bundle, and CLI
pnpm build

# 3. Verify runtime, catalog schema, OS keyring / vault, and SQLite health
pnpm doctor

# 4. Start AutoAPI proxy and dashboard on http://127.0.0.1:4141
pnpm start
```

### Docker Quickstart

```bash
# Build and launch bound strictly to 127.0.0.1:4141 with persistent /data volume
docker compose up -d --build
```

---

## CLI Reference

```bash
# Start local proxy & dashboard (opens browser unless --no-open is passed)
autoapi start [--port 4141] [--host 127.0.0.1] [--data-dir <dir>] [--no-open] [--no-sync]

# Safely merge all virtual model pools into an existing local OpenCode or Continue config (creates .autoapi.bak backup)
autoapi connect <opencode|continue> [--model auto-coder] [--port 4141] [--host 127.0.0.1] [--no-default] [--dry-run]

# Query a running AutoAPI instance for uptime, keys, tokens, and savings
autoapi status [--port 4141] [--host 127.0.0.1]

# Run environment, catalog, keyring, AES-256-GCM vault, SQLite, and port diagnostics
autoapi doctor [--port 4141] [--data-dir <dir>]

# Print or rotate the local proxy Bearer token (aapi_...)
autoapi token [--regenerate] [--data-dir <dir>]
```

---

## Connecting Coding Agents

1. Open `http://127.0.0.1:4141` and add API keys under **Providers & Vault** (use **Test Ping** or **Sync Models** to verify and pull live callable models).
2. Open **Routing Studio** and drag-and-drop your `Key + Model` entries into virtual pools:
   - `auto-coder` (default: Priority Order, Tool Calling required, Auto-Rotate Keys enabled, 32K+ context)
   - `auto-fast` (default: Lowest Latency, 16K+ context)
   - `auto-long` (default: Priority Order, Tool Calling required, 128K+ context)
3. Open **Connect Agents** to either install AutoAPI non-destructively into OpenCode / Continue with one click (preserving existing providers and creating an `.autoapi.bak` backup) or copy/download configurations:
   - **OpenCode** (`opencode.json` with `@ai-sdk/openai-compatible` pointed at `http://127.0.0.1:4141/v1`)
   - **Cline (VS Code)** & **Roo Code** (`OpenAI Compatible` provider preset)
   - **Continue.dev** (`~/.continue/config.yaml`)
   - **OpenAI SDK / cURL**

## Automated Discovery Pipeline (GitHub Actions)

The `@autoapi/discovery` package powers two scheduled workflows and CI under `.github/workflows/`:

- **CI** (`.github/workflows/ci.yml`): Builds, type-checks, runs all Vitest suites, and executes `autoapi doctor` across Linux, Windows, and macOS (Node 22) on push and pull requests to `main`.
- **Daily Discovery Sync** (`.github/workflows/discovery-sync.yml`): Scans `r/LocalLLaMA`, `r/ClaudeAI`, `r/OpenAI`, `r/cursor`, Awesome Free LLM GitHub lists, and hashes official provider documentation (`catalog/docs-hashes.json`) to detect rate-limit/pricing changes. When `DISCOVERY_LLM_API_KEY` (and optional `DISCOVERY_LLM_BASE_URL` / `DISCOVERY_LLM_MODEL`) repository secrets are configured, new candidates are extracted via Structured Output, validated with Zod, and opened as a Pull Request for human approval.
- **12-Hour Endpoint Health Check** (`.github/workflows/catalog-health.yml`): Probes active catalog endpoints, tracks consecutive failures, marks providers unreachable for **`>= 72 hours`** as `deprecated` (auto-recovering when reachable again), and opens a PR on status changes.

Run locally:

```bash
pnpm discovery:run
pnpm discovery:health
```

---

## Security & Privacy Architecture

- **Loopback Isolation**: Listens strictly on `127.0.0.1` by default — not exposed to your LAN or external networks.
- **Local Access Authentication**: All `/v1/*` proxy routes require a locally generated Bearer token (`aapi_...`) by default (toggleable and regenerable in Settings or via `autoapi token --regenerate`).
- **Encryption at Rest**: User API keys (plus optional X API Bearer tokens) are encrypted with **AES-256-GCM** using a 32-byte master key stored in your OS Credential Manager (`Windows Credential Manager`, `macOS Keychain`, or `Linux Secret Service` via `@napi-rs/keyring`), falling back cleanly to `AUTOAPI_MASTER_KEY` or a `0600` local `master.key` in headless containers.
- **Zero Telemetry & Secret Scrubbing**: Prompt contents and API keys are never sent to any central service. Request logs scrub known tokens/keys defensively, and prompt payload logging to SQLite is **OFF** by default (only enabled temporarily if you toggle Debug Mode in Settings).

---

## Monorepo Structure

```text
AutoAPI/
├── .github/workflows/      # CI, scheduled discovery, & 72h health-check GitHub Actions
├── catalog/catalog.json    # Curated starter catalog (12 providers)
├── Dockerfile              # Multi-stage container build (non-root node user + /healthcheck)
├── docker-compose.yml      # Loopback-bound Compose service with persistent /data volume
├── packages/
│   ├── shared/             # Zod schemas, OpenAI & domain types (@autoapi/shared)
│   ├── core/               # Vault, SQLite, adapters, quota tracker, router, Hono server (@autoapi/core)
│   ├── dashboard/          # React + Vite + Tailwind CSS v4 + dnd-kit UI (@autoapi/dashboard)
│   ├── discovery/          # Collectors, Radar filter, LLM extractor, doc watcher, health checker (@autoapi/discovery)
│   └── cli/                # `autoapi` CLI entrypoint (start, connect, status, doctor, token)
├── package.json
├── pnpm-workspace.yaml
└── vitest.config.ts
```

## Development & Testing

```bash
pnpm typecheck   # Type-check all 5 packages
pnpm build       # Build shared, discovery, core, dashboard bundle, cli & stage assets
pnpm test        # Run Vitest unit, integration, E2E mock upstream, and concurrency stress tests
```
